notes.per_fold: mean ± std over CV folds (LOSO: one fold per subject; kfold5: 5 subject folds)
notes.pooled: metrics over all out-of-fold predictions together
notes.T3: each subject has one T3 class, so LOSO per-fold metrics are undefined; use pooled / recording
notes.units: classical LOSO rows are scored per 4-s epoch; 5-fold comparison rows per 18-s sequence

preprocess_summary.note_low_usable: These subjects are KEPT. Bad windows are only excluded when an experiment sets exclude_bad_windows=true.
